name: ClaritX forward-tested AI stock-selection record
description: Pre-registered AI stock-selection strategies measured forward against a total-return S&P 500. Rules frozen before measurement; losing arms published.

files.title: Forward performance by AI score band
files.description: Every completed analysis scored 0-100 when published, then measured forward against a total-return S&P 500 over the same window, grouped into score bands. Snapshot 2026-09-24, 1,055 analyses.

files.title: Archived nightly cohort snapshots
files.description: The same cohort measurement re-run and archived every night: 48 dated snapshots from 2026-07-17 to 2026-09-24, 288 rows. Best and worst holding named in each.

citation: ClaritX Research Engine, "Forward-tested AI stock-selection record", snapshot 2026-09-24. https://www.claritx.ai/research
